example.title: Astoria Riverfront Trolley line on its riverside trestle (opened 1999)

brief: A single-track heritage trolley line opened in 1999 on the former railway along the river: steel rails on a timber-sleepered bed running along the waterfront and out over the river shallows on a low timber trestle of creosoted pile bents with a plank walkway beside, with small red-roofed open shelters at the stops and a red-and-cream 1913 trolley car. Four photos. Piles carried 10 m or more below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
